contexts.text: These are afterwards distinguished from each other; so that some are retained, but others removed.
For the Intellectual discerns between apparent truths and truths themselves...
That ye may know that Jehovah doth distinguish between the Egyptians and Israel () = the nature of the difference between those who are in evil and those who are in good.
They do not discern between truth and falsity...
They can well distinguish between these (scientifics), adopting those which... and rejecting those which...
They distinguish between the things which are of light and of shade.
The latter and the former can be but little distinguished, because one cannot distinguish between the light of confirmation and the light of the perception of truth.

The Angels distinguish in the extremes what is lascivious from what is not lascivious, as one distinguishes a fire of dung... from a fire of spices... and this from the difference of the internal delights...
Although not discerned in the world, they are discerned in Heaven.
But after death these are well discerned...
So that the difference is scarcely discerned...
Thus, also, are they discerned, as to their quality...
They who discern the inmost essences...
From this light is... the faculty of judging, of discerning, and of choosing.
They who had injured virgins, without distinction...
They speak lies, without any discernment, or distinction.
Thus they could not distinguish good from evil...
